problemFound: The canonical facade sash-latch builder froze its formal root only in static fields using GetInstanceID(). A script/domain reload resets those fields. The central reflection fingerprint could therefore call the parent preparation path again and reinterpret a deleted/replaced but structurally valid latch root as a new baseline. Render-state hashing tracks hierarchy and render payload, but intentionally does not establish persistent scene-object identity, so a byte/structure-equivalent replacement root could evade that identity question.

Delegated the existing sash-latch structural/material/LOD/weathering validator at every reflection-lighting fingerprint evaluation.
